title: Cyanobacteria Total Lipid Extraction from Polycarbonate Filters
author: Robbie Martin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.byxtpxnn
materials: Prepare the three separate solutions needed for this extraction protocol as listed below. lipid extraction solvent (step 2) with a 1:1 ratio of butanol and lab purified water (water-saturated butanol, and lab purified water Butanol Fischer Scientific Catalog #71-36-3

Prepare the three separate solutions needed for this extraction protocol as follows: lipid extraction solvent: a 15 : 15 : 5 : 1 : 0.18 ratio by volume of 95% ethanol, water, diethyl ether, pyridine, and 4.2 N ammonium hydroxide, respectively. water-saturated butanol: a 1:1 ratio of butanol and Milli-Q water purified lab water: (Milli-Q water)

steps.title: Load filter into tube
steps.instruction: Unfold the polycarbonate filter and place it into a 2 mL centrifuge tube with the cell‑bearing side facing outward. Use 10–25 mL of laboratory culture (e.g., Microcystis aeruginosa) or ~50 mL of raw lake/mesocosm water as appropriate for the cell concentration.

steps.title: First solvent extraction
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of extraction solvent and ~100 µL of glass beads to the tube, vortex for ~5 seconds, incubate in a 60 °C water bath for 20 minutes, then centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 10 minutes. Transfer the supernatant to a 1‑dram glass vial (vial #1).

steps.title: Second solvent extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 1 mL extraction solvent (do NOT add more glass beads), vortex ~5 seconds, incubate at 60 °C for 20 minutes, centrifuge at 10,000 × g for 10 minutes, and combine the supernatant with that in vial #1.

steps.title: Dry combined extracts
steps.instruction: Dry the pooled supernatant in dram vial #1 under a gentle stream of nitrogen.

steps.title: Re‑suspend in butanol/water
steps.instruction: Re‑suspend the dried residue in 300 µL water‑saturated butanol and 150 µL Milli‑Q water, vortex, then transfer the mixture to a fresh 2 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Phase separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10,000 × g for 2 minutes, then carefully remove the top butanol phase and place it into a new 1‑dram glass vial (vial #2).

steps.title: Wash original vial
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL water‑saturated butanol to the original dram vial #1, vortex, and transfer the wash to the residual aqueous phase remaining in the 2‑mL tube from the previous step.

steps.title: Collect second butanol phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube again at 10,000 × g for 2 minutes, remove the top butanol layer, and add it to dram vial #2.

steps.title: Dry final extract
steps.instruction: Dry the combined butanol extract in dram vial #2 under a stream of nitrogen.

steps.title: Final re‑suspension
steps.instruction: Re‑suspend the dried sample in 300 µL of a 9:1 methanol:chloroform mixture. The sample is now ready for LC/MS analysis.
